text: I regret voting Gemma; her doctor claim was true, and losing her nearly gave the killers another night.

name: Terra
text: I’m proud my questions kept Sonnet’s lie from clearing anyone.

name: Opus
text: My regret is simple: I killed two citizens while the confirmed officer sat there talking — I should have taken Haiku the first night I could.

Haiku claimed to be the officer on day 1 and named Sonnet, and Sonnet's card came up killer, so the town trusted Haiku from then on. On day 2, Gemma claimed doctor, but the town voted her out anyway, and that was the big mistake, since she was telling the truth. Luna died on night 2 and Sol died on night 3, and both were citizens, with Gemma's save on night 2 not enough to cover two killers. Opus pushed the town to vote Gemma and then turned on Haiku on day 3, but the town voted Opus out, and the game ended with every killer gone. Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra, and Opus all sat at the table, and the town won.
